title: Unexposed
description: A resource pack that changes exposed back to lightly weathered to bring back "waxed lightly weathered cut copper stairs"
body:
# Unexposed

Bring back Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Stairs

## Why?

Because mojang decided it was a good idea to replace lightly weathered with exposed, obviously thats a problem so time to bring it back.

## How?

Resource packs have the ability to overwrite language files
